Autonomous submission of protest against complicit media outlet The Jerusalem Post: 

On Monday, May 19th, autonomous activists protested outside of @thejerusalem_post Conference at the Pierre Hotel in Upper East Side Manhattan. The annual conference brought together some of the leading Israeli propagandists and their supporters in NYC. Guest speakers included Israeli War Cabinet member Benny Gantz, disgraced NYC Mayor Eric Adams, and Israeli Minister of Culture Miki Zohar, who has advocated for both the starvation of Palestinians and the annexation of Gaza.

Protesters called out J-Post and the guest speakers’ complicity in the genocide, as Israel intensifies its assault on Gaza through ground invasions and rampant bombing. The issue is also a local one: over $500 million of New York taxpayer money is sent to Israel each year. This money could be used to improve the lives of families here, but instead is used to supply the weapons killing mostly women and children in Palestine.

Despite aggression from both Zionist conference-goers and NYPD, protesters made their message clear: war criminals and genocide supporters are not welcome in NYC.

Video content credits: @saraerenthalart and others
